files.document_title: Public Service Commission of Wisconsin, Rochester Lateral Project 6630-CG-139 project map, linked from the case page
files.what_it_shows: A one-page color map of the full project from Rochester Gate near Highway 20 in the west to the Oak Creek plant on Lake Michigan in the east. It draws Route A, Route B, shared Route AB and connector Route C, with valve assembly sites, county highways and a scale bar. It is a map of alternatives. The route the Commission authorized on December 2, 2025 is the applicant's preferred route, a combination of Route A segments, Route B segments and Route C connectors, so no single colored line on the map is the authorized route.

files.what_it_shows: The same alternatives map as figure 1 of the environmental assessment, in a smaller frame. The text beside it says Route A is about 32.9 miles and Route B about 33.2 miles.

notes: The Commission authorized the applicant's preferred route on December 2, 2025. It is a mix of Route A, Route B and Route C connector segments, with the fewest pipeline miles of the three options. The map in the gallery shows the alternatives, so a georeferencer must pick the right segments. The application's Attachment 10 Preferred Route Map would show the authorized route directly and is worth one more search of docket 6630-CG-139. Both routes are about 33 miles, which matches the sheet. The final decision PDF is saved beside the maps as PSC_final_decision_6630-CG-139.pdf and the environmental assessment as PSC_environmental_assessment_6630-CG-139.pdf.
